title: Checks for lifetime annotations which can be replaced with anonymous lifetimes ('_).
summary: The additional lifetimes can make the code look more complicated. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of if expressions with an else if branch, but without a final else branch.
summary: Some coding guidelines require this (e.g., MISRA-C:2004 Rule 14.10). Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
